name: msgf-pulse-guard
description: V3.2-ULTRA IDE guard — buffers keystroke Pulses and routes to MSGF (SHARD / CROSS-REF / CONVERGE).

msgf.tenantKey.description: Tenant key sent as X-MSGF-Tenant-Key (and x-msgf-tenant-id). Falls back to workspace folder name.

msgf.authToken.description: Personal or service token sent as Authorization: Bearer for POST /api/msgf/pulse.

msgf.role.description: V3.2 operator tier (maps to x-msgf-access-role on Pulse requests).

msgf.organizationId.description: Team / company silo id (x-msgf-organization-id). When empty with a personal token, sandbox company_admin fallback may apply.

msgf.apiUrl.description: MSGF API base URL (Cloud Run or local Next app) for POST /api/msgf/pulse.

msgf.licenseKey.description: Contract license or service token (Bearer) for IDE Pulse when not using browser session auth.

msgf.entityId.description: Optional stable developer machine id (x-msgf-entity-id). Defaults to a generated id per machine.
